data.long_meaning: The name Aubyn is derived from the Old French word 'Albain', which means 'elf, friend' or 'love'. The name Aubyn carries the meaning “Friend, love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aubyn usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
